items.text: Simpler outline shape on every correction
Leader line touches the outline
Key portions of code text highlighted
"Turns on" changed to "Depends on"
Removed: "Assumed for this demonstration" line
Removed: HERE label
Removed: footer disclaimer
Less text: one line per rule, details only for the selected rule
Outline easier to see, white only, no black edge
Map pin slides quickly to where you press, then follows while you hold
Remove the statewide paragraph and the hatched-zones footnote
Switching tabs: no flash, no reload, each tab keeps its state
Minimap with a draggable pin that changes the senior's screen
Short questionnaire in place of the long check list; app fills in what it can see
Photo prompt: "It should look something like this" with the diagram; no sample link
Remove the "other sprinkler heads in the room" check
Fix fields and options cut off at the edges
"Is this what you mean?": first reading is the top option, already selected
Camera screen: remove two labels, gallery becomes an icon button
Minimal view: one-line rules that expand for detail
Remove circles, the "AI wording" line, sample findings and demo notices
"Open" becomes "Still to confirm"; plain words and labelled buttons throughout
Steps with a breadcrumb: finding, how to fix it, drafts, publish
Fixes desk: tick, reword, ask for a rewrite, set aside, write your own
Drafts for the owner and for the file, editable before publishing
This queue button
Outline is a switch: off by default, turn on to see what changed
Removed: the correction tags ("Inspector-preferred", "Alternative")
Checked: the "outside" label was right; the diagonal lines were streets on the basemap. Zones are now dotted so it cannot be confused
Remove every instruction or how-to sentence ("At the pin", "Move the pin…" and the like)
Sprinkler outline made bigger so it frames the whole sprinkler
Rule rows: the 30 ft / 100 ft values sit with the rule name, no floating column
Left card shrinks and grows with the photo (no empty space for the sprinkler)
Fixed: Inspectors tab was blank
Fourth city researched: Berkeley (5 ft no-burn zone in the hills, spacing out to 100 ft)
Gleb components on both tabs (add ?gleb=0 to the address to compare with the old look)
Berkeley on the map: a pill that flies the pin across the Bay
Hide the "Received" column when nothing has arrived
Phone frame back to real phone proportions
Work queue: newest first, no flashing
Year question: show the typed digits clearly above the keypad; "I can't see a year" as a quiet option
Removed: "The app filled in 2 things… Check them"
Verdict control: pressing "Inspector's call" morphs into a red / green toggle
Common actions become symbol buttons (Enlarge first); rule saved to the design system
Remove every instruction or how-to sentence on the Inspectors tab
Redesign the Violation / Clear switch (no black circle; same style as the top tabs)
Berkeley flight: real map all the way across, preloaded, one smooth slide
Remove the minimap from the Inspectors tab
Camera screen: shutter and gallery button low at the bottom, viewfinder taller; then even spacing on every phone screen
Redesign the scan: photo dims, a line passes top to bottom, only the finding stays lit
Photo is shown clean after the scan (no box or tag on it), on the phone and the laptop
"Change wording" buttons become a pencil icon beside each text
Removed: "The app read this as… Put it back" line (tap the chosen side again to undo)
Redesign "For the owner": a desktop website preview, clean photo, short text; "For the file" as a proper document
Drafts: click anywhere in the text and type to edit (no "Change wording" button)
Scrolling areas fade softly at the top and bottom (rule saved to the design system)
"Take it back" / "Put it back" become Undo
Berkeley pill on its own second row
Fix: text piles up on itself when switching Ladder fuel / Painted sprinkler
Heading "Is this what you mean?" becomes "Add a note"
Sprinkler | Hedge pill moves above the photo, off the picture
New sprinkler photo: swap it in, re-place the marks, rebuild the "after" image to match
"How to fix it": large before / after for the selected fix, with its steps beside it
Phone and laptop the same height on the stage
Editing a note option: text stays and becomes editable in place; the pencil turns into a check in the same spot
"Show what changed": outline fades out when switched off
More space between the Sprinkler | Hedge pill and the photo
More space between the back button and the screen title
Removed: the Rewrite "What is wrong" button
Scan: all the marks fade out together at the end
"Or type the feet" becomes "Or type the distance"
No hold gestures: Send, Approve and Publish are a single tap
Rules stay in place when a verdict is changed (no automatic re-sorting)
"How to fix it": the large picture changes on click, not hover
Owner page: "Options for how to fix it", each fix labelled Option 1, Option 2…
Removed: the "For the owner" title bar and its undo button
Owner website preview: uses the whole laptop screen, roomier layout, plus an Enlarge view
Flow reordered: Finding, How to fix it, For the file, For the owner (publish happens on the last step)
Removed: the "Fire code by location · Ross Valley" title
More margin inside the rounded cards so text does not crowd the corner
Work queue scrollbar no longer rides into the rounded corner
A little more space between the photo and the camera buttons
Top tabs and buttons sit slightly lower
Put the project on GitHub (when everything above is done)
